choose.when: SELECT s.qualification_id,q.amount,q.expires_at,s.state,s.ledger_id FROM ad_click_settlement s JOIN ad_click_quote q ON q.quote_id=s.qualification_id,scope p WHERE q.advertiser_id=p.advertiser_id AND s.budget_date=p.budget_date

SELECT s.qualification_id,q.amount,q.expires_at,s.state,s.ledger_id FROM ad_conversion_settlement s JOIN ad_conversion_quote q ON q.quote_id=s.qualification_id,scope p WHERE s.advertiser_id=p.advertiser_id AND s.budget_date=p.budget_date
choose.otherwise: SELECT r.reservation_id qualification_id,r.amount,r.expires_at,r.state,NULL::uuid ledger_id FROM ad_budget_reservation r,scope p WHERE r.advertiser_id=p.advertiser_id AND r.budget_date=p.budget_date

mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM ad_billing_schema_history WHERE version=#{version}
WITH scope AS (SELECT 0::bigint advertiser_id,DATE '1970-01-01' budget_date) LIMIT 0

SELECT advertiser_id,limit_amount,held_amount,charged_amount,version FROM ad_budget_account WHERE traffic_class='SANDBOX' AND currency='CNY' AND advertiser_id=#{scope.advertiserId} AND budget_date=#{scope.budgetDate}

WITH scope AS (SELECT #{scope.advertiserId}::bigint advertiser_id,#{scope.budgetDate}::date budget_date,#{observedAt}::timestamptz observed_at), obligations AS (), ledger AS (SELECT l.* FROM l,scope p WHERE l.advertiser_id=p.advertiser_id AND l.budget_date=p.budget_date), facts AS (SELECT f.* FROM f,scope p WHERE f.advertiser_id=p.advertiser_id AND f.budget_date=p.budget_date), daily AS (SELECT d.* FROM d,scope p WHERE d.advertiser_id=p.advertiser_id AND d.budget_date=p.budget_date) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM obligations WHERE state='HELD') held_count, (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount),0) FROM obligations WHERE state='HELD') held_amount, (SELECT count(*) FROM obligations,scope p WHERE state='HELD' AND expires_at<=p.observed_at) expired_held_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM ledger) ledger_count,(SELECT coalesce(sum(amount),0) FROM ledger) ledger_amount, (SELECT count(*) FROM obligations o LEFT JOIN ledger l ON l.qualification_id=o.qualification_id WHERE o.state='CAPTURED' AND l.ledger_id IS NULL) missing_ledger_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM ledger l LEFT JOIN obligations o ON l.qualification_id=o.qualification_id WHERE o.qualification_id IS NULL OR o.state<>'CAPTURED' OR o.amount<>l.amount OR (#{ledgerIdentityRequired} AND o.ledger_id IS DISTINCT FROM l.ledger_id)) invalid_ledger_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM ledger l JOIN o ON o.event_id=l.ledger_id WHERE o.delivery_state IN ('READY','SENDING')) pending_outbox_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM ledger l JOIN o ON o.event_id=l.ledger_id WHERE o.delivery_state='DEAD') dead_outbox_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM ledger l LEFT JOIN o ON o.event_id=l.ledger_id WHERE o.event_id IS NULL) missing_outbox_count, (SELECT min(o.created_at) FROM ledger l JOIN o ON o.event_id=l.ledger_id WHERE o.delivery_state IN ('READY','SENDING')) oldest_pending_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts) fact_count,(SELECT coalesce(sum(amount),0) FROM facts) fact_amount, (SELECT count(*) FROM ledger l LEFT JOIN f ON f.event_id=l.ledger_id WHERE f.event_id IS NULL) missing_fact_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM ledger l JOIN f ON f.event_id=l.ledger_id WHERE f.qualification_id<>l.qualification_id OR f.advertiser_id<>l.advertiser_id OR f.budget_date<>l.budget_date OR f.amount<>l.amount) invalid_fact_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts f LEFT JOIN ledger l ON f.event_id=l.ledger_id WHERE l.ledger_id IS NULL) unexpected_fact_count, (SELECT max(applied_at) FROM facts) last_applied_at, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM daily) summary_present, coalesce((SELECT FROM daily),0) summary_count,coalesce((SELECT charged_amount FROM daily),0) summary_amount
